members.reason: ["First end of the single clause not citable. By its own terms the standstill ran 'for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President'. The date the board made its report (cover and transmittal letter dated November 20, 1954, Chicago, Emergency Board No. 107, NMB Case A-4599) appears only in PDF pages 1-2 of PEB-107-Report.pdf (sha256 841bb65f01dee3a98ee4723200aebe1989141a7113b86d2e1555f6e9edc2adaa; text jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_10570_Actual_report_date_..._f1cbeae2b3.txt; bytes verified held in the dispatch check) and no packet evidence record covers that span: the packet's TERM records for that text cover only the introduction and later pages, and the order's own text gives no date. A source supplement or reviewed FACT record for the report date (cover/letter span) is needed before the own-terms end (30 days after the report, 1954-12-20 on the letter date) can be cited. The 1986 revocation by EO 12553 (1986-02-25) is only a formal disposition and an upper bound, not the first end, under the 2026-10-28 ruling."]

["Whole order formally revoked 2025-01-20 (EO 14148 sec. 2(w); EO 14159 sec. 3(a)), but the first end of the time-limited commands is unresolved. Sec. 3(b),(c), 4(b), 5(a),(b),(d) require plans, reports and a strategy to be submitted to the President (60, 90 and 180-day deadlines); a deadline is not an end and no held source shows that any of them was submitted (they are internal Executive Branch submissions; searches of held texts for the Task Force on New Americans and Naturalization Working Group found only the order and orders citing it). Sec. 3 and 4 reviews, sec. 5(c) working group and sec. 6 review duties have no end other than revocation, with the performed revocation of the 2019 sponsor memorandum on 2021-02-02 as a separate exhausted act. Missing: held evidence of actual submission or completion of each deadline command, or a decision that revocation on 2025-01-20 extinguished each unperformed command with the first end recorded only as not later than that date."]
